reserved_effect_names.Nirvana: converts all damage the marked character DEALS into an equal Nullify on itself
reserved_effect_names.Plasmantle: converts all Harmful damage the marked character TAKES into an equal Shield
reserved_effect_names.Blood Spear: absorbs every non-Bleed hit into a same-named DAMAGE effect instead of dealing it
reserved_effect_names.Saturn Crystal: halves all incoming damage and redirects the rest to an ally
reserved_effect_names.Silence Wall: halves all incoming damage and redirects the rest to a random ENEMY
reserved_effect_names.Ruinous Scythe: turns the Saturn Crystal redirect into HEALING for the ally
reserved_effect_names.Heavenly Intervention: reduces a lethal hit to 0 and deals 35 back to the attacker
reserved_effect_names.Fourth Form: Shifting Flow Slash: while the holder is Blinded, incoming damage is discarded entirely
reserved_effect_names.Embrace Pain: instant_kill returns early — immune to every execute
reserved_effect_names.Sealed Nightmare: an IGNORE_DAMAGE effect of this name also makes instant_kill return early
reserved_effect_names.Post-Mortem Nen: converts the holder's death into a free 3-turn immortality
reserved_effect_names.Unexpected Beheading: check_beheading runs on EVERY hp change and executes when mag >= hp; `mag` is authorable
reserved_effect_names.Iron Maiden: a self-applied mark makes the holder untargetable by everyone
reserved_effect_names.Sealed King: a self-applied mark makes the holder untargetable by everyone
reserved_effect_names.Gibbet: restricts who may target the marked character to the mark's own user
reserved_effect_names.Tsubaki Mode: Kusarigama: is_invuln() returns false for every skill the marked character uses — free invuln-piercing
reserved_effect_names.Fairy Star Blessing: cost() returns all zeros — every skill on the marked character is free
reserved_effect_names.Named Reconstitution: the marked character generates NO energy at turn start
reserved_effect_names.Terror Incarnate: reflects every harmful hit received back at the attacker in full
reserved_effect_names.Ultimate Nightmare: reflects every harmful hit received at the WHOLE enemy team
reserved_effect_names.Lord of Gluttony: heals the marked dealer mag% of ALL damage it deals; `mag` is authorable
reserved_effect_names.Blade of the Dragon King: an ability of this name gains a permanent stacking +5 every time it meets a shield/barrier/DR
reserved_effect_names.Rankyaku Gaicho: an ability of this name erases every counter and reflect from its targets before executing
reserved_effect_names.Uranus Lip Rod: pairs with World Shaking for +5 damage on every hit
reserved_effect_names.World Shaking: pairs with Uranus Lip Rod for +5 damage on every hit
reserved_effect_names.Snake Fire: lets a trigger planted on an ENEMY fire on the author's own team's attacks
reserved_effect_names.Data Collection: on a Kurotsuchi ally, permanently reveals every invisible enemy effect
reserved_effect_names.Crush Card Virus: a MARK branch separate from its DAMAGE_CAP one (:179) — forces every invisible effect the holder applies to become VISIBLE, and needs no particular teammate
reserved_effect_names.Warp Digivolve - Beelzemon: marked_by() heal multiplier (:1095) reading `mag` as a percent — a plain authored mark leaves mag at 0, so `healing * 0 / 100` means the marked ENEMY can never be healed again
reserved_effect_names.Soul Gem: Madoka: calls gain_corruption() on the holder — a method only Madoka has

_reserved_effect_names_note: name -> WHY it is reserved. These are effect names the engine special-cases by STRING, so any content system that lets a user pick an effect name must refuse these.
_hero_shield_bound_note: Elemental HERO fusions whose whole effect ends when their Shield breaks. Absences are deliberate (Clayman, Avian, Burstinatrix, Bubbleman) — see the source comment.
